description: Adversary emulation scripts for the MITRE ATT&CK Discovery tactic (TA0007). Covers 10 scriptable parent techniques: service enumeration, registry query on sensitive paths, network configuration discovery, remote system/host discovery via ARP and NetBIOS, network connection enumeration, process discovery, permission group enumeration, system information gathering, account discovery, and network share enumeration. All scripts are read-only, require no Administrator privileges, make no system changes, and generate zero persistent artefacts. They produce MDE process creation and LDAP telemetry monitored by Microsoft Sentinel built-in analytics rules for post-exploitation reconnaissance activity.
author: X3M.AI
prerequisites: Windows 10/11 or Windows Server 2019/2022 test machine with Morgana agent installed
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE) onboarded and data connector active in Microsoft Sentinel
No Administrator privileges required for any script in this pack
For T1018 (remote system discovery): network access to at least one subnet is beneficial but not required - the ARP table and NetBIOS scan are attempted regardless
For T1087 (account discovery LDAP variant): a domain-joined machine is required for the Active Directory user enumeration step; the local user enumeration step always succeeds
Test environment only - never run against production systems or monitored production environments

tag_categories.label: T1018 - Remote System Discovery
tag_categories.description: Settings for the remote system discovery script. The subnet prefix is used to build a ping sweep range. Use a test lab subnet. Discovery is also attempted via the ARP cache (passive) and NetBIOS node status regardless of ping results.

tags.label: Target Subnet Prefix (first 3 octets)
tags.description: First three octets of the subnet to sweep (e.g. 192.168.1). The script will attempt ICMP ping to .1 through .20 of this prefix. Use your lab network. Keep the range small for fast execution.

tag_categories.label: T1083 - File and Directory Discovery (sensitive paths)
tag_categories.description: Settings for the file and directory discovery script. The script always enumerates a fixed set of high-value adversary target paths (C:\Users, C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc, C:\inetpub). The configurable path is an additional custom directory to enumerate.

tags.label: Additional Path to Enumerate
tags.description: An additional directory path to list during file/directory discovery. Combined with the fixed sensitive path set. Use a path that exists on the test machine.

scripts.name: Excalibur - Discovery-T1007-System Service Discovery
scripts.description: Enumerates all Windows services using Get-Service and sc.exe query, simulating adversary reconnaissance of running services to identify targets for privilege escalation, lateral movement, or persistence. Three enumeration methods are used: Get-Service (PowerShell), sc.exe query type= all (LOLBin), and WMIC service list. Multi-method service enumeration is a known post-exploitation recon pattern detected by MDE. No changes are made to any service.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1007 - System Service Discovery (multi-method enumeration)'; try { Write-Host '[INFO] Method 1/3: Get-Service (PowerShell)'; $svcs = Get-Service -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $running = @($svcs | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq 'Running' }).Count; $stopped = @($svcs | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq 'Stopped' }).Count; Write-Host ('[INFO]   Total services: ' + $svcs.Count + ' | Running: ' + $running + ' | Stopped: ' + $stopped); $svcs | Select-Object -First 5 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.Name + ' [' + $_.Status + '] ' + $_.DisplayName) }; if ($svcs.Count -gt 5) { Write-Host ('    ... and ' + ($svcs.Count - 5) + ' more') } } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] Get-Service error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; try { Write-Host '[INFO] Method 2/3: sc.exe query type= all (LOLBin - generates process creation telemetry)'; $scOutput = & sc.exe query type= all state= all 2>&1 | Select-String 'SERVICE_NAME|STATE' | Select-Object -First 10; $scOutput | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.ToString().Trim()) }; Write-Host '    [INFO] sc.exe query output truncated to 10 lines' } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] sc.exe error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; try { Write-Host '[INFO] Method 3/3: WMIC service list brief (LOLBin - WMI provider host invocation telemetry)'; $wmicOutput = & wmic.exe service list brief 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 6; $wmicOutput | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.ToString().Trim()) }; Write-Host '    [INFO] WMIC output truncated to 5 entries' } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] WMIC error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1007 - System service discovery completed. Sentinel target: System service enumeration LOLBin pattern (MDE process creation - sc.exe / wmic.exe post-exploitation recon)'
scripts.cleanup_command: Write-Host '[INFO] T1007 cleanup: no artefacts - read-only enumeration only'
scripts.detection_rule: System service enumeration LOLBin pattern (sc.exe / wmic.exe process creation)

scripts.name: Excalibur - Discovery-T1012-Query Registry
scripts.description: Queries the Windows registry across a set of high-value adversary target paths: autostart entries (Run/RunOnce), installed software, current logged-on user SID, UAC policy settings, LSA configuration, and RDP enabled state. Uses both reg.exe (LOLBin generating process creation telemetry) and Get-ItemProperty. Multi-path registry reconnaissance is a standard post-exploitation pattern. Read-only - no registry values are written.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1012 - Query Registry (multi-path adversary recon)'; $regTargets = @( @{ Path='HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run'; Label='HKCU Run keys (user autostart)' }, @{ Path='HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run'; Label='HKLM Run keys (system autostart)' }, @{ Path='HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall'; Label='Installed software (Uninstall keys)' }, @{ Path='HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon'; Label='Winlogon settings' }, @{ Path='HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa'; Label='LSA security settings' }, @{ Path='HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server'; Label='RDP enabled/disabled (fDenyTSConnections)' }, @{ Path='HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System'; Label='UAC policy settings' } ); foreach ($target in $regTargets) { try { $items = Get-ItemProperty -Path $target.Path -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($items) { $props = ($items.PSObject.Properties | Where-Object { $_.Name -notmatch '^PS' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name) -join ', '; Write-Host ('[INFO] ' + $target.Label + ': ' + $props) } else { Write-Host ('[INFO] ' + $target.Label + ': (empty or access denied)') } } catch { Write-Host ('[INFO] ' + $target.Label + ': (error - ' + $_.Exception.Message + ')') } }; Write-Host '[INFO] LOLBin query via reg.exe query (generates process creation telemetry for MDE)'; try { $regOutput = & reg.exe query 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion' /v ProductName 2>&1; Write-Host ('    ' + ($regOutput | Where-Object { $_ -match 'ProductName' })) } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] reg.exe error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1012 - Registry query completed. Sentinel target: Suspicious registry query patterns (MDE - reg.exe LOLBin process creation + sensitive key access telemetry)'
scripts.cleanup_command: Write-Host '[INFO] T1012 cleanup: no artefacts - read-only registry queries only'
scripts.detection_rule: Suspicious registry query patterns (reg.exe LOLBin + sensitive key access)

scripts.name: Excalibur - Discovery-T1016-Network Configuration Discovery
scripts.description: Enumerates local network configuration using multiple methods: ipconfig /all (LOLBin - all adapters, DNS, DHCP), Get-NetAdapter + Get-NetIPAddress (PowerShell), route print (routing table), and nslookup on the local domain (DNS resolution chain). Multi-method network configuration enumeration is a standard post-exploitation step. All methods generate process creation telemetry in MDE.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1016 - System Network Configuration Discovery (multi-method)'; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 1/4: ipconfig /all (LOLBin)'; try { $ipcOutput = & ipconfig.exe /all 2>&1; $ipcLines = @($ipcOutput) | Where-Object { $_ -match 'IPv4|DNS|Default Gateway|DHCP|Adapter' } | Select-Object -First 12; $ipcLines | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.ToString().Trim()) } } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] ipconfig error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 2/4: Get-NetAdapter + Get-NetIPAddress (PowerShell)'; try { $adapters = Get-NetAdapter -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq 'Up' }; foreach ($a in $adapters) { $ips = (Get-NetIPAddress -InterfaceIndex $a.InterfaceIndex -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.AddressFamily -eq 'IPv4' }).IPAddress -join ', '; Write-Host ('    ' + $a.Name + ' [' + $a.Status + '] ' + $a.MacAddress + ' -> ' + $ips) } } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] Get-NetAdapter error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 3/4: route print (routing table LOLBin)'; try { $routeOutput = & route.exe print 2>&1 | Where-Object { $_ -match '0\.0\.0\.0|Active Routes' } | Select-Object -First 5; $routeOutput | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.ToString().Trim()) } } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] route print error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 4/4: nslookup local domain (DNS discovery)'; try { $domain = $env:USERDNSDOMAIN; if ($domain) { $nsOutput = & nslookup.exe $domain 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 4; $nsOutput | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.ToString().Trim()) } } else { Write-Host '    [INFO] Machine not domain-joined - skipping nslookup domain query' } } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] nslookup error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1016 - Network configuration discovery completed. Sentinel target: Network configuration enumeration LOLBin pattern (MDE - ipconfig / route / nslookup process creation)'
scripts.cleanup_command: Write-Host '[INFO] T1016 cleanup: no artefacts - read-only network configuration queries only'
scripts.detection_rule: Network configuration enumeration LOLBin pattern (ipconfig / route / nslookup)

scripts.name: Excalibur - Discovery-T1018-Remote System Discovery
scripts.description: Performs remote host discovery using three methods: (1) ARP cache enumeration (passive - no network traffic, shows recently contacted hosts); (2) ping sweep of the configured subnet prefix .1 through .20 (active ICMP); (3) NetBIOS node status query via nbtstat -A against discovered live hosts. ARP + ping sweep + nbtstat is the standard adversary host discovery chain. MDE detects the nbtstat LOLBin process creation and the rapid ICMP pattern.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1018 - Remote System Discovery (ARP + ping sweep + NetBIOS)'; $subnet = '#{excalibur_disc_t1018_subnet}'; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 1/3: ARP cache enumeration (passive - no network traffic)'; try { $arpOutput = & arp.exe -a 2>&1 | Where-Object { $_ -match '\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+' -and $_ -notmatch 'Interface|Address' }; $arpHosts = @($arpOutput).Count; Write-Host ('[INFO]   ARP cache entries: ' + $arpHosts); @($arpOutput) | Select-Object -First 5 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.ToString().Trim()) } } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] ARP enumeration error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host ('[INFO] Method 2/3: Ping sweep ' + $subnet + '.1-20 (active ICMP - 500ms timeout per host)'); $liveHosts = @(); 1..20 | ForEach-Object { $ip = $subnet + '.' + $_; $result = Test-Connection -ComputerName $ip -Count 1 -TimeoutSeconds 1 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue -Quiet; if ($result) { $liveHosts += $ip; Write-Host ('[INFO]   Live host: ' + $ip) } }; Write-Host ('[INFO]   Ping sweep complete - live hosts: ' + $liveHosts.Count + '/20'); Write-Host '[INFO] Method 3/3: nbtstat -A (NetBIOS node status) on discovered live hosts (LOLBin)'; if ($liveHosts.Count -gt 0) { foreach ($host in ($liveHosts | Select-Object -First 3)) { try { $nbOutput = & nbtstat.exe -A $host 2>&1 | Where-Object { $_ -match '<' } | Select-Object -First 3; Write-Host ('[INFO]   nbtstat ' + $host + ':'); $nbOutput | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.ToString().Trim()) } } catch { Write-Host ('[INFO]   nbtstat ' + $host + ': no response') } } } else { Write-Host '[INFO]   No live hosts in range - nbtstat invoked against subnet gateway for telemetry generation'; try { $null = & nbtstat.exe -A ($subnet + '.1') 2>&1 } catch {} }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1018 - Remote system discovery completed. Sentinel target: Host enumeration LOLBin pattern (MDE - arp.exe / nbtstat.exe process creation + rapid ICMP sweep detection)'
scripts.cleanup_command: Write-Host '[INFO] T1018 cleanup: no artefacts - read-only network discovery only'
scripts.detection_rule: Host enumeration LOLBin pattern (arp.exe / nbtstat.exe process creation)

scripts.name: Excalibur - Discovery-T1049-Network Connections Discovery
scripts.description: Enumerates active and listening network connections using multiple methods: netstat -ano (LOLBin - all connections with owning PIDs), Get-NetTCPConnection (PowerShell), and Get-NetUDPEndpoint. Adversaries enumerate active connections to identify network segmentation, find other active sessions, and locate services to target. netstat is one of the most commonly used post-exploitation LOLBins and is well-covered by MDE process creation monitoring.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1049 - System Network Connections Discovery (multi-method)'; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 1/3: netstat -ano (LOLBin - all connections with owning PIDs)'; try { $netstatOutput = & netstat.exe -ano 2>&1 | Where-Object { $_ -match 'ESTABLISHED|LISTENING' }; $established = @($netstatOutput | Where-Object { $_ -match 'ESTABLISHED' }).Count; $listening = @($netstatOutput | Where-Object { $_ -match 'LISTENING' }).Count; Write-Host ('[INFO]   ESTABLISHED: ' + $established + ' | LISTENING: ' + $listening); $netstatOutput | Select-Object -First 5 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.ToString().Trim()) }; if ($netstatOutput.Count -gt 5) { Write-Host ('    ... and ' + ($netstatOutput.Count - 5) + ' more') } } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] netstat error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 2/3: Get-NetTCPConnection (PowerShell)'; try { $tcpConns = Get-NetTCPConnection -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $estConns = @($tcpConns | Where-Object { $_.State -eq 'Established' }); Write-Host ('[INFO]   TCP connections (PowerShell): ' + $tcpConns.Count + ' total | ' + $estConns.Count + ' established'); $estConns | Select-Object -First 3 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    LocalPort=' + $_.LocalPort + ' RemoteAddress=' + $_.RemoteAddress + ':' + $_.RemotePort + ' PID=' + $_.OwningProcess) } } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] Get-NetTCPConnection error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 3/3: Get-NetUDPEndpoint (UDP listeners)'; try { $udpEndpoints = Get-NetUDPEndpoint -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ('[INFO]   UDP endpoints: ' + $udpEndpoints.Count) } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] Get-NetUDPEndpoint error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1049 - Network connections discovery completed. Sentinel target: Network connection enumeration LOLBin (MDE - netstat.exe process creation post-exploitation recon pattern)'
scripts.cleanup_command: Write-Host '[INFO] T1049 cleanup: no artefacts - read-only connection enumeration only'
scripts.detection_rule: Network connection enumeration LOLBin (netstat.exe process creation)

scripts.name: Excalibur - Discovery-T1057-Process Discovery
scripts.description: Enumerates running processes using three methods: tasklist.exe /v (LOLBin - verbose, includes username column), Get-Process (PowerShell), and WMIC process list full (WMI telemetry). Adversaries enumerate processes to find security tools to kill, identify victim software for credential harvesting, and map the environment. The combination of tasklist + wmic process enumeration is a well-known post-exploitation fingerprint.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1057 - Process Discovery (multi-method enumeration)'; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 1/3: tasklist.exe /v (LOLBin verbose - generates process creation telemetry)'; try { $tasklistOutput = & tasklist.exe /v /fo csv 2>&1 | ConvertFrom-Csv | Select-Object -First 5 -Property 'Image Name','PID','Status','User Name'; $total = (& tasklist.exe /fo csv 2>&1 | ConvertFrom-Csv).Count; Write-Host ('[INFO]   Total processes: ' + $total + ' (showing first 5)'); $tasklistOutput | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.'Image Name' + ' (PID=' + $_.PID + ', User=' + $_.'User Name' + ')') } } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] tasklist error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 2/3: Get-Process (PowerShell - all processes with memory/CPU)'; try { $procs = Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ('[INFO]   Process count: ' + $procs.Count + ' | Top 3 by CPU:'); $procs | Sort-Object CPU -Descending | Select-Object -First 3 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.ProcessName + ' PID=' + $_.Id + ' CPU=' + [math]::Round($_.CPU, 2) + 's WorkingSet=' + [math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64/1MB, 1) + 'MB') }; Write-Host '[INFO] Looking for common security tools in running processes:'; $secTools = @('MsMpEng','MsSense','csfalconservice','CylanceSvc','cb','bdservicehost','SentinelAgent','LogCollector'); $found = @($procs | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -in $secTools }); if ($found) { Write-Host ('[INFO]   Security processes found: ' + ($found.ProcessName -join ', ')) } else { Write-Host '[INFO]   No known AV/EDR processes found in running list' } } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] Get-Process error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 3/3: WMIC process list brief (WMI process telemetry)'; try { $wmicOutput = & wmic.exe process list brief 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 4; $wmicOutput | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.ToString().Trim()) } } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] WMIC error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1057 - Process discovery completed. Sentinel target: Process enumeration LOLBin pattern (MDE - tasklist.exe / wmic.exe process creation + security tool enumeration)'
scripts.cleanup_command: Write-Host '[INFO] T1057 cleanup: no artefacts - read-only process enumeration only'
scripts.detection_rule: Process enumeration LOLBin pattern (tasklist.exe / wmic.exe process creation)

scripts.name: Excalibur - Discovery-T1069-Permission Groups Discovery
scripts.description: Enumerates local and domain permission groups using three methods: net.exe localgroup administrators (LOLBin - Administrator group membership), Get-LocalGroup + Get-LocalGroupMember (PowerShell local), and [adsisearcher] LDAP query for domain groups (if domain-joined). Adversaries enumerate group memberships to identify privileged accounts, find lateral movement paths, and target high-value users. net.exe localgroup is one of the most common post-exploitation LOLBins.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1069 - Permission Groups Discovery (local + domain)'; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 1/3: net.exe localgroup administrators (LOLBin)'; try { $netOutput = & net.exe localgroup administrators 2>&1 | Where-Object { $_ -match '\S' }; $netOutput | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.ToString().Trim()) } } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] net localgroup error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 2/3: Get-LocalGroup + Get-LocalGroupMember (PowerShell)'; try { $groups = Get-LocalGroup -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ('[INFO]   Total local groups: ' + $groups.Count); $privilegedGroups = @('Administrators', 'Remote Desktop Users', 'Remote Management Users', 'Backup Operators', 'Power Users'); foreach ($groupName in $privilegedGroups) { try { $members = Get-LocalGroupMember -Group $groupName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($members) { Write-Host ('[INFO]   Group: ' + $groupName + ' (' + $members.Count + ' member(s)): ' + (($members | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name) -join ', ')) } } catch { Write-Host ('[INFO]   Group: ' + $groupName + ' - (not found or access denied)') } } } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] Get-LocalGroup error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 3/3: LDAP domain group enumeration (requires domain-joined machine)'; if ($env:USERDNSDOMAIN) { try { $searcher = [adsisearcher]'(&(objectCategory=group)(groupType:1.2.840.113556.1.4.803:=2147483648))'; $searcher.SizeLimit = 15; $searcher.PropertiesToLoad.AddRange(@('samaccountname', 'description')) | Out-Null; $domGroups = $searcher.FindAll(); Write-Host ('[INFO]   Domain security groups (top 10): ' + $domGroups.Count + ' returned'); $domGroups | Select-Object -First 10 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.Properties['samaccountname'][0]) }; $searcher.Dispose() } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] LDAP domain group query failed: ' + $_.Exception.Message) } } else { Write-Host '[INFO]   Machine not domain-joined - skipping domain group LDAP query' }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1069 - Permission groups discovery completed. Sentinel target: Privileged group membership enumeration LOLBin (MDE - net.exe localgroup process creation + LDAP group query telemetry)'
scripts.cleanup_command: Write-Host '[INFO] T1069 cleanup: no artefacts - read-only group enumeration only'
scripts.detection_rule: Privileged group membership enumeration LOLBin (net.exe localgroup + LDAP)

scripts.name: Excalibur - Discovery-T1082-System Information Discovery
scripts.description: Gathers comprehensive system information using three methods: systeminfo.exe (LOLBin - OS version, hotfixes, memory, domain, boot time), Get-ComputerInfo (PowerShell), and environment variable enumeration (COMPUTERNAME, PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE, USERNAME, USERDOMAIN). systeminfo is the single highest-value post-exploitation LOLBin for system fingerprinting and is always present in MDE process creation telemetry after compromise.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1082 - System Information Discovery (multi-method)'; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 1/3: systeminfo.exe (LOLBin - primary system fingerprint command)'; try { $sysinfoOutput = & systeminfo.exe 2>&1 | Where-Object { $_ -match 'OS Name|OS Version|System Type|Total Physical|Domain|Hotfix|Boot Time' }; $sysinfoOutput | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.ToString().Trim()) } } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] systeminfo error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 2/3: Get-ComputerInfo (PowerShell structured system info)'; try { $ci = Get-ComputerInfo -Property 'CsName','WindowsProductName','OsVersion','OsArchitecture','CsProcessors','CsTotalPhysicalMemory','OsLastBootUpTime' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($ci) { Write-Host ('    Host: ' + $ci.CsName + ' | OS: ' + $ci.WindowsProductName + ' ' + $ci.OsVersion + ' (' + $ci.OsArchitecture + ')'); $memGB = [math]::Round($ci.CsTotalPhysicalMemory/1GB, 1); Write-Host ('    Memory: ' + $memGB + ' GB | Last boot: ' + $ci.OsLastBootUpTime) } } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] Get-ComputerInfo error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 3/3: Environment variable system fingerprinting'; $envVars = @('COMPUTERNAME','PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE','PROCESSOR_IDENTIFIER','NUMBER_OF_PROCESSORS','OS','USERDOMAIN','USERNAME','USERPROFILE','SystemDrive','ProgramFiles','CommonProgramFiles'); foreach ($v in $envVars) { $val = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($v); if ($val) { Write-Host ('    ' + $v + '=' + $val) } }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1082 - System information discovery completed. Sentinel target: System fingerprinting LOLBin (MDE - systeminfo.exe process creation - highest-fidelity post-exploitation recon indicator)'
scripts.cleanup_command: Write-Host '[INFO] T1082 cleanup: no artefacts - read-only system information queries only'

scripts.name: Excalibur - Discovery-T1087-Account Discovery
scripts.description: Enumerates local and domain user accounts using multiple methods: net.exe user (LOLBin - local accounts), Get-LocalUser (PowerShell - local with password age and enabled status), and [adsisearcher] LDAP query for enabled domain users with last logon (if domain-joined). Adversaries enumerate accounts to map the environment, identify service accounts, and select high-value targets for credential attacks. net user is one of the top 5 most-used post-exploitation LOLBins.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1087 - Account Discovery (local + domain)'; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 1/3: net.exe user (LOLBin - local user enumeration)'; try { $netUserOutput = & net.exe user 2>&1 | Where-Object { $_ -match '\S' }; $netUserOutput | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.ToString().Trim()) } } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] net user error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 2/3: Get-LocalUser (PowerShell - detailed local accounts)'; try { $localUsers = Get-LocalUser -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ('[INFO]   Total local accounts: ' + $localUsers.Count); $localUsers | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.Name + ' [' + $(if ($_.Enabled) { 'ENABLED' } else { 'DISABLED' }) + '] LastLogon=' + $(if ($_.LastLogon) { $_.LastLogon.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd') } else { 'Never' }) + ' PasswordLastSet=' + $(if ($_.PasswordLastSet) { $_.PasswordLastSet.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd') } else { 'N/A' })) } } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] Get-LocalUser error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 3/3: LDAP domain user enumeration (requires domain-joined machine)'; if ($env:USERDNSDOMAIN) { try { $searcher = [adsisearcher]'(&(objectCategory=person)(objectClass=user)(!userAccountControl:1.2.840.113556.1.4.803:=2))'; $searcher.SizeLimit = 20; $searcher.PropertiesToLoad.AddRange(@('samaccountname', 'displayname', 'lastlogontimestamp', 'description')) | Out-Null; $domUsers = $searcher.FindAll(); Write-Host ('[INFO]   Enabled domain users found: ' + $domUsers.Count + ' (top 10 shown)'); $domUsers | Select-Object -First 10 | ForEach-Object { $lastLogon = 'Never'; try { $llts = $_.Properties['lastlogontimestamp'][0]; if ($llts) { $lastLogon = [DateTime]::FromFileTime($llts).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd') } } catch {}; Write-Host ('    ' + $_.Properties['samaccountname'][0] + ' LastLogon=' + $lastLogon) }; $searcher.Dispose() } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] LDAP domain user query failed: ' + $_.Exception.Message) } } else { Write-Host '[INFO]   Machine not domain-joined - skipping domain user LDAP query' }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1087 - Account discovery completed. Sentinel target: User account enumeration LOLBin (MDE - net.exe process creation + LDAP query for user objects telemetry)'
scripts.cleanup_command: Write-Host '[INFO] T1087 cleanup: no artefacts - read-only account enumeration only'
scripts.detection_rule: User account enumeration LOLBin (net.exe user + LDAP user query)

scripts.name: Excalibur - Discovery-T1135-Network Share Discovery
scripts.description: Enumerates local and remote network shares using multiple methods: net.exe share (LOLBin - local shares), Get-SmbShare (PowerShell - detailed with permissions), net.exe view /all (LOLBin - shares visible on the local network), and Get-SmbMapping (mapped drives). Adversaries enumerate shares to find data repositories, identify lateral movement paths, and locate files for collection or exfiltration. net share and net view are classic LOLBin share discovery commands.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1135 - Network Share Discovery (local + remote)'; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 1/4: net.exe share (LOLBin - local shares)'; try { $netShareOutput = & net.exe share 2>&1 | Where-Object { $_ -match '\S' }; $netShareOutput | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.ToString().Trim()) } } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] net share error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 2/4: Get-SmbShare (PowerShell - detailed local shares with access)'; try { $smbShares = Get-SmbShare -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ('[INFO]   SMB shares: ' + $smbShares.Count); $smbShares | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.Name + ' -> ' + $_.Path + ' [' + $_.ShareType + '] ' + $(if ($_.Description) { $_.Description } else { '' })) } } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] Get-SmbShare error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 3/4: net.exe view /all (LOLBin - network-visible shares)'; try { $netViewOutput = & net.exe view /all 2>&1 | Where-Object { $_ -match '\S' }; if (@($netViewOutput | Where-Object { $_ -match 'System error' }).Count -gt 0) { Write-Host '[INFO]   net view returned error (expected in workgroup or restricted environments)' } else { $netViewOutput | Select-Object -First 10 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.ToString().Trim()) } } } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] net view error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 4/4: Get-SmbMapping (mapped network drives)'; try { $mappings = Get-SmbMapping -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($mappings) { Write-Host ('[INFO]   Mapped drives: ' + $mappings.Count); $mappings | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.LocalPath + ' -> ' + $_.RemotePath + ' [' + $_.Status + ']') } } else { Write-Host '[INFO]   No mapped network drives found' } } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] Get-SmbMapping error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1135 - Network share discovery completed. Sentinel target: Network share enumeration LOLBin (MDE - net.exe share / net.exe view process creation post-exploitation recon pattern)'
scripts.cleanup_command: Write-Host '[INFO] T1135 cleanup: no artefacts - read-only share enumeration only'
scripts.detection_rule: Network share enumeration LOLBin (net.exe share / net.exe view process creation)

chains.name: Excalibur - Discovery-T1007-System Service Discovery
chains.description: Emulation chain for T1007: system service enumeration via Get-Service, sc.exe and wmic.exe. Validates MDE process creation detection for service discovery LOLBins.

chains.name: Excalibur - Discovery-T1012-Query Registry
chains.description: Emulation chain for T1012: registry query on autostart, installed software, LSA, UAC and RDP keys via reg.exe LOLBin. Validates MDE sensitive registry access telemetry.

chains.name: Excalibur - Discovery-T1016-Network Configuration Discovery
chains.description: Emulation chain for T1016: network configuration enumeration via ipconfig, route, and nslookup LOLBins. Validates MDE process creation telemetry for network recon.

chains.name: Excalibur - Discovery-T1018-Remote System Discovery
chains.description: Emulation chain for T1018: remote host discovery via ARP cache enumeration, ICMP ping sweep, and nbtstat NetBIOS node status. Validates MDE host discovery LOLBin detection.

chains.name: Excalibur - Discovery-T1049-Network Connections Discovery
chains.description: Emulation chain for T1049: active connection enumeration via netstat -ano LOLBin and Get-NetTCPConnection. Validates MDE process creation detection for network connection recon.

chains.name: Excalibur - Discovery-T1057-Process Discovery
chains.description: Emulation chain for T1057: process enumeration via tasklist.exe /v, Get-Process, and wmic process list. Validates MDE detection of process discovery LOLBins and security tool enumeration.

chains.name: Excalibur - Discovery-T1069-Permission Groups Discovery
chains.description: Emulation chain for T1069: permission group enumeration via net.exe localgroup, Get-LocalGroupMember, and LDAP domain group query. Validates MDE LOLBin + LDAP telemetry detection.

chains.name: Excalibur - Discovery-T1082-System Information Discovery
chains.description: Emulation chain for T1082: system fingerprinting via systeminfo.exe, Get-ComputerInfo, and environment variable enumeration. Validates the highest-fidelity post-exploitation system recon LOLBin.

chains.name: Excalibur - Discovery-T1087-Account Discovery
chains.description: Emulation chain for T1087: user account enumeration via net.exe user, Get-LocalUser, and LDAP domain user query. Validates MDE LOLBin process creation + LDAP user query telemetry.

chains.name: Excalibur - Discovery-T1135-Network Share Discovery
chains.description: Emulation chain for T1135: network share enumeration via net.exe share, Get-SmbShare, net.exe view, and Get-SmbMapping. Validates MDE detection of share discovery LOLBin patterns.

chains.name: Excalibur - Discovery Full Sweep
chains.description: Full sweep of all 10 Discovery technique emulations. Runs sequentially on the Morgana Windows agent. All scripts are read-only and require no Administrator privileges. No system changes are made. T1018 performs an ICMP ping sweep to .1-.20 of the configured subnet - ensure the subnet parameter is set to your lab network. T1069 and T1087 include LDAP queries that require a domain-joined machine.
